technique_name: Describe the effect of technology on work/life balance.
description: Technology has had a profound effect on work/life balance. With the advent of the internet and mobile devices, workers are increasingly able to work remotely and have greater access to their jobs and colleagues outside of traditional office hours. This has the potential to greatly increase the amount of time and energy that individuals are able to dedicate to their job, making it more difficult to properly unplug and relax.
